title: NASA Astronaut Reid Wiseman at Freedom 250 Grand Prix
originalTitle: NASA Astronaut Reid Wiseman at Freedom 250 Grand Prix
content:
HQ Web Team

Aug 24, 2026

NASA astronaut and Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman is seen in the two-seat IndyCar as he prepares for driver Conor Daly to take him on a lap ahead of the start of the Freedom 250 Grand Prix, Sunday, Aug. 23, 2026, in Washington, D.C.
